title: IBARAKI-HITACHINAKA-CULTURE-MAIN BOUNDED PRODUCTION IMPLEMENTATION
scope: Single-venue bounded production implementation of ひたちなか市文化会館〔大ホール〕 (inventory ibaraki-hitachinaka-culture-main), the rank-4 ADOPT of KANTO >=1000 HIGH-IMPACT UNRESEARCHED PREFLIGHT 4. Venue 3 of 3 in the PREFLIGHT-4 ADOPT batch.
mode: fresh currentness -> chart re-fetch -> configuration -> human two-pass -> machine structural checksum -> issuer reconciliation

startSnapshot.batch: KANTO PREFLIGHT-4 ADOPT BATCH: 3-venue bounded production implementation run as three independent mini-waves in one thread, in the order saitama-koshigaya-suncity-hall, gunma-ota-culture-main, ibaraki-hitachinaka-culture-main.

currentnessGate.method: First-party pages fetched fresh on 2026-09-04 before any seat conclusion: top page with the NEWS list, 施設案内 大ホール, 今月催事スケジュール.
currentnessGate.officialUrlCorrection: The Kanto ledger and inventory recorded https://hitachinaka-culture.jp/, which does not resolve in DNS. The current official domain is https://hitachinaka-culturehall.jp/ and both records were corrected.
evidence: 施設案内 大ホール: 総客席数：1,368 席（固定：1,150席／移動席：200席／身障者席：10席／母子席：8席）, ワンスロープタイプ, オーケストラピット有り.
NEWS updated to 2026.09.03 (施設利用抽選会のお知らせ, 大人向け文化教室「オカリナ」参加者募集！).
今月催事スケジュール 令和8年9月: ticketed 大ホール events including 9/5 しまじろうコンサート 3,500円 and 9/6 半﨑美子コンサートツアー2026.
currentnessGate.closureAssessment: No permanent closure, demolition, rebuild, long closure or renovation notice exists anywhere on the current site.

reachedFrom: https://hitachinaka-culturehall.jp/archives/facility/大ホール (大ホール座席表PDF / 座席表PDF)
assetGate.notUrlGuessed: The link relation on the current facility page was re-walked on 2026-09-04.
assetGate.textLayer: Zero extractable text. As the filename's OL indicates, all type is outlined. Seat cells are vector stroke paths.
assetGate.denseVectorEligibility: REJECTED on the evidence: no identifier is printed as extractable text, so DENSE-VECTOR's identifier-reconstruction requirement cannot be met. Default human visual two-pass applied, with an independent vector-geometry structural checksum.

configurationGate.hallForm: One-slope (ワンスロープ) multipurpose hall, rows 1-30, five unnamed blocks with continuous numbering 1-56 across the row.
configurationGate.orchestraPit: The chart marks 1列〜6列 with 〔　〕 as オーケストラピット席 and notes that pit use removes them as a passage (196席). 196 equals 26+30+32+36+36+36, the printed subtotals of rows 1-6. No numbered chart for the pit state is published, so no second configuration was derived by subtraction.
configurationGate.unnumberedPositions: 車イス補助席 (5 compartments each side, at 9列/10列) and 母子席 (4 x 2 at the bottom centre): 10 + 8 = 18, matching the facility page's 身障者席10席 / 母子席8席.
configurationGate.decision: One representative configuration `standard`, scope.kind full-venue, single unnamed area with the chart's own row numbers 1-30.

targetDiscipline.rule: 総座席数 1,350, 総客席数 1,368 and the printed per-row subtotals were used only as post-transcription reconciliation.
targetDiscipline.practice: The transcription was resolved against the chart geometry and the row-number columns; where the machine clustering and the printed subtotals disagreed, the chart was re-read rather than a figure chosen.

passA.label: human visual Pass 1
passA.order: Front section rows 1->18 by block (far-left, left, centre, right, far-right), then rear rows 19->30.

passB.label: human visual Pass 2
passB.order: Read from the opposite side and anchored differently: the far-right blocks with the adjacent row-number column, and the far-left blocks with their own adjacent row-number column, at 1,000-2,000 dpi with independently re-cut crops.
passB.resolvedAmbiguities: Confirmed directly that the 3-seat and 4-seat outer blocks belong to 7列 and 8列, that 16列 and 17列 carry the full 1〜10 / 47〜56 outer blocks, and that 18列 has no outer block at all.

humanComparison.method: Frozen tables compared in both directions on expanded (row, seat-number) keys.

machineStructuralChecksum.feasibility: Practical. Every seat cell is an individual vector stroke rectangle.
machineStructuralChecksum.independence: Derived from PDF vector stroke geometry alone. No text exists to read, and the human range table was never a count source.
machineStructuralChecksum.method: All stroke drawings were enumerated and filtered to seat-cell dimensions (width 6.0-14.0 pt, height 8.0-14.0 pt), then chained into rows by nearest-neighbour adjacency; cell width classes were tabulated separately as a second, independent structural signal.
machineStructuralChecksum.nonSeatStrokes: 14 (figure outline, block frames, the single-path 車イス補助席 5-compartment box at 37.6 x 16.0 pt, and its dashed caption box).
machineStructuralChecksum.circledDoorMarkers: 5 of the 1,354 are 9.0 x 9.0 pt four-bezier circles Ⓐ Ⓑ Ⓒ Ⓓ Ⓕ, not seats.
machineStructuralChecksum.mergedCell: The 19列 far-left seat 9 cell is drawn inside a 200.4 x 195.7 pt nine-item composite path (the section outline) and is therefore not an independent rectangle.

widthClassCrossCheck.rearOuterBlocks_8.5pt: 159 = (2 x 5 + 10 x 7) x 2 - 1 merged cell, rows 19-30

issuerChecksumReconciliation.row18: No subtotal is printed for 18列. 758 minus the 722 of rows 1-17 gives 36, equal to the transcribed 18列.
issuerChecksumReconciliation.differences: Every printed per-row subtotal, both section subtotals, the chart header 1,350, the 固定1,150 + 移動200 = 1,350 breakdown, and 1,350 + 10 + 8 = 1,368 all reconcile with difference 0.

wheelchairSemantics.whereDrawn: 車イス補助席: one unnumbered box of 5 compartments at each side of 9列/10列. 母子席: an unnumbered 4 x 2 block at the bottom centre.
wheelchairSemantics.replacesOrdinaryPrintedIds: No. 1,350 printed + 10 + 8 = 1,368, and the drawn compartment counts (10 and 8) equal the published figures.

productionArtifacts.rowLabels: 1〜30 (the chart's own row numbers; the app renders them as n列)

prohibitionsObserved: capacity fitting: not used. Every mapped identifier was read from the current official chart before any issuer total was compared.
invented seat IDs: none. No identifier, row, block or area was created that the chart does not print.
configuration mixing: none. Only one issuer-published numbered chart per venue was transcribed.
unsupported geometry completion: none. Missing positions were left unmapped rather than interpolated.
third-party infill: none. Only current first-party issuer material was used.
DENSE-VECTOR: not applied. Eligibility was assessed per venue and failed or was unnecessary; the default fresh independent human visual two-pass was used throughout.
no soft-limit threshold change, no compaction, and no unrelated refactor was made.

build.note: Succeeded on the first attempt. No retry, no empty commit and no local production deploy; the managed GitHub-connected Cloudflare Workers Build was the only deploy path.
